To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the diversity gain of cellular systems with multiple antennas is limited by the inter-cell interference and 2) the multiplexing gain is determined by the number of antennas at the base station and the number of users per cell, but not the number of antennas of the mobile user.

the inter-cell interference will decrease the diversity order and increase the multiplexing gain of cellular systems, and the inter-cell interference intensity has a great impact on the system performance.
The inter-cell interference can be treated as an additional noise in cellular systems, and it can be modeled as the sum of multiple Gaussian noises with different power and covariance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a fundamental tradeoff between the diversity and multiplicity of a cellular system.
the tradeoff between the system reliability and multiplexing efficiency in the uplink cellular systems.
the DMT analysis for the uplink of the cellular systems with multiple antennas.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the inter-cell interference would degrade the system performance of cellular systems with multiple antennas.
the inter-cell interference is detrimental to the system diversity and multiplex-ing tradeoff.
the inter-cell interference is a major obstacle to the system reliability and capacity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, with the increasing of the number of antennas and multiplexing gain, the inter-cell interference becomes the main performance limiting factor for the system reliability.
the inter-cell interference is a double-edged sword for cellular systems, which could be beneficial for the system reliability and detrimental for system efficiency.
the inter-cell interference is the main obstacle for the performance of cellular systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, the inter-cell interference can degrade the diversity order and multiplexing gain of the cellular system.
, the inter-cell interference can be mitigated by using multiple antennas, and the system can achieve a high reliability with a high multiplexing gain.
the inter-cell interference is a key factor to limit the system performance, and it is more harmful to the system reliability than the system efficiency.
